hooks.command: echo '[Hook] Review changes before push...' >&2; echo '[Hook] Continuing with push (remove this hook to add interactive review)' >&2

PreToolUse.description: Reminder before git push to review changes

hooks.command:
python3 -c "import sys, json, re; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); (re.search(r'\.(md|txt)$',p) and not re.search(r'(README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING)\.md$',p)) and (sys.stderr.write('[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file creation
[Hook] File: '+p+'
[Hook] Use README.md for documentation instead
') or sys.exit(1)); print(d,end='')"

PreToolUse.description: Block creation of random .md files - keeps docs consolidated

hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys, json, re; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); cmd=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); m=re.search(r'gh pr create',cmd) and re.search(r'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/\d+',i.get('tool_output',{}).get('output','')); m and sys.stderr.write('[Hook] PR created: '+m.group()+'\n[Hook] To review: gh pr review '+m.group().split('/')[-1]+' --repo '+'/'.join(m.group().split('/')[3:5])+'\n'); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL and provide review command after PR creation

hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; d=sys.stdin.read(); i=json.loads(d); p=i.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); r=subprocess.run(['bunx','markdownlint-cli',p],capture_output=True,text=True) if p else None; r and r.stdout.strip() and sys.stderr.write(r.stdout.strip()+'\n'); r and r.stderr.strip() and sys.stderr.write(r.stderr.strip()+'\n'); print(d,end='')"

PostToolUse.description: Lint markdown files with markdownlint after edits
